paragraphs: NodeFlow is an open-source, browser-based architecture workspace for creating, analyzing, and editing diagrams from code source, visual canvas, starter templates, and AI agents. Keep editable multi-file projects, live previews, direct canvas tools, live diagnostics, STRIDE threat auditing, request flow simulation, and version checkpoints together. Built for 100% client-side privacy with zero telemetry.
